register_name: BHIV vNEXT MASTERDB-GEO-QUEST-01 Exception & Diagnostic Register
policy: Deterministic quarantine routing with zero silent data loss. Raw source assets remain immutable.

exception_codes.name: Missing Ingestion Provenance
exception_codes.description: Record or batch lacks upstream source URL, acquisition timestamp, or feeder lineage metadata.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Verify acquisition wrapper passes valid metadata. Ingestion feeds without origin verification cannot enter governed storage.

exception_codes.name: Null Required Identifier or Field
exception_codes.description: Mandatory non-nullable field (aircraft_hex_id, latitude, longitude) is null, empty, or absent.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Inspect feeder message decoder. Transponder frames lacking hex ID cannot be tracked or spatialized.

exception_codes.name: Malformed Data Type or Parse Error
exception_codes.description: Field value cannot be parsed or coerced to declared schema data type (e.g., non-numeric string in coordinate float).
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Sanitize upstream string serialization; quarantine invalid records to protect downstream spatial geometry engines.

exception_codes.name: Duplicate Aircraft Hex Identifier In Batch
exception_codes.description: Multiple observation records share the same 24-bit ICAO aircraft hex address within a single snapshot.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Apply tie-break by latest timestamp or route second instance to quarantine for sensor correlation audit.

exception_codes.name: Schema Non-Conformance / Missing Core Fields
exception_codes.description: Record is not a valid JSON dictionary or lacks the minimum required spatial state vector structure.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Review upstream payload schema changes and version contract compatibility.

exception_codes.name: Negative Latency / Future Timestamp Anomaly
exception_codes.description: Sensor latency ('seen', 'seen_pos') is negative or observation timestamp is ahead of the reference clock.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Investigate feeder receiver NTP clock synchronization and clock drift.

exception_codes.name: Stale Observation Age Exceeded
exception_codes.description: Observation latency exceeds maximum real-time operational shelf-life threshold (default > 3600 seconds).
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Archive to historical cold storage; exclude from active near-real-time surveillance catalog.

exception_codes.name: General Temporal / Clock Anomaly
exception_codes.description: Sensor latency or timestamp anomaly (umbrella category covering negative sensor latencies and stale thresholds).
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Inspect feeder receiver NTP clock synchronization and latency telemetry.

exception_codes.name: Kinematic Value Out of Physical Aviation Envelope
exception_codes.description: Ground speed, track angle, or altitude outside realistic physical bounds (e.g., track > 360 deg or speed > 1500 kts).
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Flag sensor bit-flip or corrupted decode. Exclude from trajectory smoothing.

exception_codes.name: Inconsistent Cross-Field Physical Measurements
exception_codes.description: Contradictory telemetry fields, such as surface aircraft (on_ground=True) reporting jet cruise speed (>120 kts) or supersonic climb rates.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Quarantine for cross-sensor sensor validation; prevent corrupted states from triggering false collision alerts.

exception_codes.name: Record Conservation Accounting Mismatch
exception_codes.description: Total raw input count does not equal sum of accepted cleaned records plus quarantined records.
exception_codes.remediation_workflow: Pipeline fatal stop: indicates memory leak, silent drop, or unhandled exception during processing.
